summary: Executed requested backend/manual-legacy regressions and frontend withdraw UI checks on preview. Backend flows pass including role-gates, validations, background-job path, idempotency, and label hiding; frontend works for role visibility and layout but misses searchable label picker requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Label selector is plain <select> (non-searchable); requirement requested searchable/select label flow.

design_issues.screen: Admin Withdraw > Tambah Riwayat Withdraw Legacy
issues: Month/date inputs use native browser pickers, producing inconsistent cross-browser UI compared to app-styled form controls.

action_items: Upgrade manual legacy label picker to searchable combobox/autocomplete to match requested admin UX.
Optional UI consistency: replace native month/date controls with shared calendar/month picker components if product requires uniform styling across browsers.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend manual legacy flow is consistent with requested logic: preview sums draft/pending/available, queue+poll completes, worker flips targeted range to withdrawn+legacy_settled, keeps post-cutoff lines untouched, updates cutoff/balances, and enforces idempotency.
Role enforcement is correct: only super_admin/admin_finance can access manual preview/commit APIs; admin_support receives 403.

Auth playbook checks pass in this run: bcrypt $2b$ hash, HttpOnly+Secure login cookies, credentialed explicit-origin CORS, brute-force lockout after 5 failures, and seed_admin password update behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core role/toggle/layout checks passed; searchable picker requirement missing)

seed_data_creation: Temporary Mongo test documents created inside backend pytest and cleaned up in finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI checks used preview URL from frontend/.env and credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Finance role can open manual panel; support role cannot see manual toggle. Desktop/mobile no horizontal overflow observed on Admin Withdraw. Preview can return business message 'Tidak ada royalti aktif...' depending selected label/range on live data.
rca of the issue: Searchable-label requirement gap: current component /app/frontend/src/components/admin/ManualLegacyWithdrawPanel.jsx renders native <select> for label input. This satisfies selection but not searchable UX requested by user. Mitigation: replace with searchable combobox (with label_name filter + selected label_id payload preserved). No API flow is MOCKED.
